bash -lc 
set -x
ls -la .github 2>&1
ls -la .github/workflows 2>&1
git ls-files ".github/*" | wc -l
gh api "repos/Pedro31051/youtube_clipper/actions/workflows" --jq ".total_count" 2>&1
gh api "repos/Pedro31051/youtube_clipper/actions/runs" --jq ".total_count" 2>&1
gh api "repos/Pedro31051/youtube_clipper/commits/fbe8cc5462537dbcaa44ddf6c9182ac218b22c25/check-runs" --jq "{total: .total_count}" 2>&1
gh api "repos/Pedro31051/youtube_clipper/commits/fbe8cc5462537dbcaa44ddf6c9182ac218b22c25/status" --jq "{state: .state, total: (.statuses|length)}" 2>&1
gh pr list --repo Pedro31051/youtube_clipper --state all --json number,title,headRefName,state 2>&1
gh api "repos/Pedro31051/youtube_clipper/branches" --jq "[.[] | {name: .name, protected: .protected}]" 2>&1
echo "--- COMMITS T0: em qual branch foram feitos ---"
git log --oneline --decorate --all --graph
echo "--- branches que contem cada commit T0 ---"
for c in 8be03ac f4f13a3 fbe8cc5 4ffe6f4; do echo "commit $c ->"; git branch -a --contains $c; done
echo "--- primeiro commit de cada branch remota ---"
git log origin/main --oneline
echo "--- regra escrita sobre commits na main ---"
grep -rn "main" agents.md PROJECT.md 2>/dev/null | grep -i "branch\|commit\|nao\|não\|proib" | head -20
echo "--- contagem de testes documentada x coletada ---"
grep -rno "4[0-9][0-9] \(testes\|tests\|passed\)" *.md review/T0/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -20

bash -lc 
echo "# INVENTÁRIO — auditoria independente T0 (run corrigido)"
echo "# gerado em: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
echo
echo "## 1. Ambiente"
echo "os              : $(. /etc/os-release; echo $PRETTY_NAME)"
echo "kernel          : $(uname -r)"
echo "arquitetura     : $(uname -m)"
echo "usuario         : $(id -un)"
echo "python (sistema): $(python3 -V 2>&1)"
echo "python (venv)   : $(.venv/bin/python -V 2>&1)"
echo "git             : $(git --version)"
echo "ffmpeg          : $(ffmpeg -version 2>&1 | head -1)"
echo "ffprobe         : $(ffprobe -version 2>&1 | head -1)"
echo "pytest          : $(.venv/bin/python -m pytest --version 2>&1 | head -1)"
echo "docker          : $(docker --version 2>&1)"
echo
echo "## 2. Baseline"
echo "baseline_plano  : fbe8cc5462537dbcaa44ddf6c9182ac218b22c25 (ponta de origin/main)"
echo "head_da_branch  : $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "branch          : $(git branch --show-current)"
echo "diff src/tests/review entre baseline e HEAD:"
git diff --stat fbe8cc5462537dbcaa44ddf6c9182ac218b22c25 HEAD -- src tests review | sed "s/^/  /"
echo "  (vazio acima = codigo auditado identico a baseline)"
echo
echo "## 3. Dependencias declaradas"
echo "### pyproject.toml"; sed "s/^/  /" pyproject.toml
echo "### requirements.txt"; sed "s/^/  /" requirements.txt
echo
echo "## 4. Pacote T0 oficial (review/T0) — tamanho e sha256"
find review/T0 -type f -printf "%10s  %p\n" | sort -k2 | while read -r sz p; do echo "  $sz  $(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d" " -f1)  $p"; done
echo
echo "## 5. Diretorio runs/ (NAO versionado) — origem real dos artefatos declarados"
echo "  arquivos versionados sob runs/: $(git ls-files runs | wc -l)"
find runs/run_t0_golden -type f -printf "%10s  %p\n" | sort -k2 | while read -r sz p; do echo "  $sz  $(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d" " -f1)  $p"; done
echo
echo "## 6. Codigo produtivo auditado"
find src -name "*.py" -printf "%10s  %p\n" | sort -k2 | while read -r sz p; do echo "  $sz  $(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d" " -f1)  $p"; done
echo
echo "## 7. Suites de teste"
find tests -name "*.py" -printf "%10s  %p\n" | sort -k2 | while read -r sz p; do echo "  $sz  $(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d" " -f1)  $p"; done
echo
echo "## 8. Integracao continua"
echo "  .github/ existe: $([ -d .github ] && echo SIM || echo NAO)"
echo "  workflows registrados na API do GitHub: $(gh api repos/Pedro31051/youtube_clipper/actions/workflows --jq .total_count 2>/dev/null)"
echo "  check-runs do commit baseline: $(gh api repos/Pedro31051/youtube_clipper/commits/fbe8cc5462537dbcaa44ddf6c9182ac218b22c25/check-runs --jq .total_count 2>/dev/null)"
echo
echo "## 9. Branches"
git branch -a -v | sed "s/^/  /"
echo
echo "## 10. Pull requests"
gh pr list --state all --limit 20 2>/dev/null | sed "s/^/  /"

echo "(vazio acima = run anterior intacto)"
